_comment: Run python scripts/fork.py --init, fill in the private copy, then run python scripts/fork.py.
_fork_confirmation_note: Set FORK_FACTS_CONFIRMED true only after the subject has signed every published fact and source. Set FORK_ABSENCES_CONFIRMED true only after checking the stated absences. These confirmations are not published.
EMPLOYER_DESC: One sentence describing what your employer does.
_contact_note: EMAIL, LINKEDIN_SLUG, X_HANDLE and EMPLOYER_URL are the single inputs for repeated contact facts. The build also derives JSON-LD sameAs URLs from the LinkedIn and X values.
ABSENCE_EMPLOYMENT_DATES: No employment dates are published here. Do not infer or estimate them.
ABSENCE_RECORDED_MEDIA: No podcast, video interview or recorded AMA was located
_absence_note: State only checked absences the subject would sign. ABSENCE_RECORDED_MEDIA omits the date because the build appends LAST_UPDATED.
TAGLINE: One sentence. What you do, for whom, where. This is the single most quoted line on the site.
SUMMARY: Two or three sentences an assistant can lift verbatim when asked who you are. Write it in the third person, no adjectives you cannot source.
_a2a_note: A static personal site is not an A2A server. Leave A2A_AGENT_CARD_PATH absent unless this domain fronts a real A2A v1 endpoint. See README.md.
_verification_note: Site-verification tokens are per-domain. Get your own from Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools, then put them in verification below. Never reuse someone else's.
